sources.excerpt: Fjord-Fuzz Super-Fuzz - **Builder:** Fjord Fuzz - **Catalog type:** Fuzz - **Research level:** Deep - **Deep research status:** Verified - **Identity:** The exact model is identified by the official Fjord Fuzz 2018 demo and independent historical coverage as the **Fjord-Fuzz Super-Fuzz**, a Super-Fuzz-based fuzz made by Fjord Fuzz. [1][2] The official Fjord Fuzz video from August 2018 describes the **Fjord-Fuzz** as a small-run pedal based on the Super Fuzz circuit. The builder says this version uses a **reworked output section**, has **no tone controls**, and includes an **octave-biasing knob** that both varies the octave character and helps tune the octave-up effect. [1] The same official description says the pedal was intended as a massive-sounding fuzz with particularly thick bass, and notes that the octave behavior differs from Foxx Tone Machine-style fuzzes because the Fjord Fuzz version does not gate out. These are builder-stated performance descriptions, not independent measurements. [1] Independent historical coverage from Guitar Pedal X lists the Fjord-Fuzz Super-Fuzz among Daniel Thornhill's earlier additional fuzz models, distinct from the later Gjallarhorn and other established-range models. [2] The same 2019 profile describes the later Gjallarhorn as a high-gain Super-Fuzz variant and separately names the earlier Fjord-Fuzz Super-Fuzz, supporting separate catalog identities.
